decision.rule: PER_TENSOR_WV_ACCEPTABLE_FOR_HLS iff pins/isolation/INT32/fixture pass, every K candidate-vs-per-row mean Jaccard >= 0.98, mean replacement count <= 1.0, mean score Spearman >= 0.995, every K candidate-vs-float mass delta >= -0.01 and NDCG delta >= -0.01, K48 Pointing prompt-utility gap delta >= -0.01 and every seed K48 candidate-vs-per-row mean Jaccard >= 0.97

grounding_prompt_utility_note: Grounding same-image Pointing prompt is descriptive only: targets are nested and the paired prompt is not a valid negative; only Pointing enters the K48 prompt-utility gate.
limitations: Float normalization, reciprocal square root, L2 and min-max remain software golden.
